Places in regions without a downloaded map can be found online with Photon, a search service for OpenStreetMap data. For this, your search text and the approximate map position (rounded to about 1 km) are sent to the server, by default photon.komoot.io, operated by komoot. Nothing else is sent. Online results are only added when the offline search finds little or the map of the region is missing. You can switch this off at any time in Settings → Online search.
